text: Plate QC Average: MeanPlate(c,medRt,b,p)=1|QCb,p|∑∈QCb,pyi,c,medRt\text{Mean}_{\text{Plate}}(c, \text{medRt}, b, p) = \frac{1}{|\text{QC}_{b,p}|} \sum_{\\text{QC}_{b,p}} y_{, c, \text{medRt}} Global QC Average: MeanGlobal(c,medRt)=1|QCtotal|∑∈QCtotalyi,c,medRt\text{Mean}_{\text{Global}}(c, \text{medRt}) = \frac{1}{|\text{QC}_{\text{total}}|} \sum_{\\text{QC}_{\text{total}}} y_{, c, \text{medRt}} Plate Correction Factor (CF): CFb,p,c,medRt=MeanPlate(c,medRt,b,p)MeanGlobal(c,medRt)\text{CF}_{b, p, c, \text{medRt}} = \frac{\text{Mean}_{\text{Plate}}(c, \text{medRt}, b, p)}{\text{Mean}_{\text{Global}}(c, \text{medRt})} Batch-Corrected Sample Intensity: ycorrected,=yraw,iCFb,p,c,medRty_{\text{corrected}, } = \frac{y_{\text{raw}, }}{\text{CF}_{b, p, c, \text{medRt}}} compound measured plate QC samples, replace_missing_ave_cf() substitutes missing CF average correction factor across available metabolites plate.

title: QC Pipeline & Correction Methodology
text: RP_Pos mode, first QC injection plate historically presents analytical outlier due column conditioning. Passing exclude_first = TRUE qc_steps() removes first QC injection per plate prior computing plate QC averages:
code: # Targeted RP_Pos correction dropping initial QC outlier rescale_RPpos <- qc_steps(   dirpath = dirpath,   filename = "DO_Plasma_RP_Pos_Targeted_For_Batch_Correction.csv",   exclude_first = TRUE )

title: QC Pipeline & Correction Methodology
text: untargeted metabolomics, LC-MS platforms may output multiple chromatographic peaks per compound corresponding different retention times. Untargeted Assays: Grouping performed across (compound, medRt) pairs ensure peak independently corrected. Targeted Assays: Grouping defaults compound medRt unique.

title: QC Pipeline & Correction Methodology
text: evaluate automated QC correction manual expert curation (done 20231127 Founder Plasma benchmark), hand_auto() calculates compound-wise ratios across samples: Ratio=ValuehandValueauto\text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{Value}_{\text{hand}}}{\text{Value}_{\text{auto}}} Visualizing resulting ratio automated value estimates (log⁡10\log_{10} scale) per batch plate allows rapid detection systematic curation biases outlier plates.

title: Package Refactoring & Data Reorganization
text: metabolomics datasets Kibbey Lab / Attie Lab systems genetics studies expanded across study cohorts (Founder plasma, Diversity Outbred liver, Diversity Outbred plasma), metabr needed transition project-specific, one-analysis scripts standardized, parameterized data processing pipeline. Key goals refactoring: Standardize Data Layout: Replace ad-hoc root folders unified, dated directory hierarchy data/"QC Batch Correction". Unify QC Automation: Transition separate annual scripts (QC_Automation_2023.Rmd, QC_Automation_2025.Rmd) single parameterized pipeline (QC_Automation.Rmd). Harmonize Function APIs: Ensure consistency argument naming (e.g. exclude_first vs. legacy flags) handle missing plate CF imputations. Establish Developer Infrastructure: Implement standard agentic instructions (AGENTS.md), living developer guide (DEVELOPER.md), comprehensive pkgdown vignettes.

title: Metabolite Data Processing
text: metabr R package metabolite data ingestion, automated quality control (QC) batch correction, normalization, curation discrepancy analysis. Developed mass spectrometry metabolomics data (El-MAVEN / LC-MS) systems genetics studies (Kibbey Lab / Attie Lab), metabr automates plate--plate QC pool batch correction prepares standardized datasets downstream analysis.

title: Metabolite Data Processing
text: Data Ingestion: Flexible import raw LC-MS peak-area spreadsheets (CSV multi-sheet Excel) targeted untargeted assays (read_raw_metab(), read_batch_metab(), read_metab_minute()). Automated QC Batch Correction: Automated plate-level correction factor calculation based pooled QC samples (qc_steps(), calc_cf(), correct_raw_cf()). Missingness Handling: Automatic substitution plate-wide average correction factors metabolites missing specific plate QC runs (replace_missing_ave_cf()). Untargeted Peak Support: Seamlessly accommodates multiple chromatographic peaks per compound differentiated retention time (medRt). Curation Diagnostics: S3 class ggplot2 diagnostics evaluate visualize concordance automated corrections manual hand curation (hand_auto(), autoplot()). Standardized Export: Reshaping export long-format data wide CSV matrices ready downstream pipelines (write_metab()).

what: Option 1: Automated QC Pipeline via QC_Automation.Rmd
title: Metabolite Data Processing
text: package includes end--end parameterized R Markdown workflow QC_Automation.Rmd automatically resolves paths selected batch date, runs QC correction across modes (HC_Neg RP_Pos) assay types (targeted untargeted), exports standardized CSV matrices: Cohort-specific historical notebooks also available: - QC_Automation_2023.Rmd: Founder Plasma study (benchmarked manual hand curation via hand_auto()). - QC_Automation_2025.Rmd: Diversity Outbred () Liver study. core pipeline routine QC_Automation.Rmd calls qc_steps() across mode:
code: library(metabr)  # 1. Render report for default batch (20261020): rmarkdown::render("QC_Automation.Rmd")  # 2. Or render for an earlier cohort / batch: rmarkdown::render("QC_Automation.Rmd", params = list(batch_date = "20251112")) rmarkdown::render("QC_Automation.Rmd", params = list(batch_date = "20231127"))  # Or open and step through interactively: # file.edit("QC_Automation.Rmd") # Targeted data rescale_HCneg <- qc_steps(   dirpath = raw_dir,   filename = files$hc_neg_tar,   exclude_first = FALSE )  rescale_RPpos <- qc_steps(   dirpath = raw_dir,   filename = files$rp_pos_tar,   exclude_first = TRUE # Exclude 1st QC run on plate if historically unstable )  # Untargeted data rescale_HCnegU <- qc_steps(   dirpath = raw_dir,   filename = files$hc_neg_untar,   exclude_first = FALSE )  rescale_RPposU <- qc_steps(   dirpath = raw_dir,   filename = files$rp_pos_untar,   exclude_first = TRUE )  # Export batch-corrected datasets to wide CSV matrices write_metab(rescale_HCneg, file.path(out_dir, "HC_Neg_Targeted.csv")) write_metab(rescale_HCnegU, file.path(out_dir, "HC_Neg_Untargeted.csv"), target = FALSE) write_metab(rescale_RPpos, file.path(out_dir, "RP_Pos_Targeted.csv")) write_metab(rescale_RPposU, file.path(out_dir, "RP_Pos_Untargeted.csv"), target = FALSE)

title: Metabolite Data Processing
text: Alternatively, execute individual stages correction pipeline directly R:
code: # 1. Read raw metabolite peak-area data raw_metab <- read_raw_metab(dirpath, "Founder_Plasma_Raw.csv")  # 2. Compute plate-level and global QC correction factors (CF) qc_factors <- calc_cf(raw_metab)  # 3. Impute missing plate CFs with average plate CF qc_factors <- replace_missing_ave_cf(qc_factors)  # 4. Rescale sample peak areas using correction factors rescaled_metab <- correct_raw_cf(raw_metab, qc_factors)
